title: Structural Experiments as Framing Mechanism
summary: Establishes structural experiments — quick, externalized, diagnostic trials in a candidate form (a paragraph, a sketch, a few bullet points) — as the framing conversation's primary mechanism for navigating the four dimensions of ADR-027, replacing discursive discussion of forms with trying them on. The agent proposes experiments and may draft a starting version, but the writer must produce their own; a failed experiment is treated as diagnostic, clarifying what the material needs, rather than wasted effort.
mechanism: structural experiments: quick, externalized, diagnostic trials in a candidate narrative form

links.note: replaces ADR-013's Phase 3 framing conversation's discursive discuss-and-select approach with try-and-discover structural experiments.
structural experiments naturally produce the epistemic engagement ADR-016 requires at the gate — trying on forms is inherently generative.

structural experiments are the mechanism for navigating ADR-027's four dimensions; the two ADRs are designed to work together, though experiments can run with a simpler vocabulary if the four-dimension model is not adopted.
structural experiments that reveal incoherence may surface new research questions that trigger ADR-029's synthesis-to-research re-entry.
